correctness.rationale: Directly expand the published integrating-factor SSPRK2/3 Shu–Osher stages to composite trapezoid and Simpson sums with positive weights. For any real-spectrum cyclic matrix-input pair, every nonzero output functional of exp(-tA)b is a nonzero real exponential polynomial with at most d-1 zeros; d distinct sampled vectors thus span and fewer can be extended to d. This proves the universal rank staircase and exact continuous strict positivity. The 3-state nilpotent weighted Vandermonde determinant is h^9/3456 and the continuous Hilbert-moment determinant is h^9/8640, giving the exact factor 5/2. Packaged Python checker independently confirms stages, ranks and determinants over 248 exact cases; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.
